# Ganesha My Bestie — Image Audit
## Auto-generated by Claude Code per scene

---

## How to generate this file

Run this in Claude Code for each scene:
"Read IMAGE_AUDIT.md and sceneRegistry.js.
Then read [scene file path].
Also scan the scene's folder for all image files.
Fill in the scene section below.
Update the SUMMARY section when done."

Always start with Scene 01 (NewModakSceneV7) as benchmark.

---

## What Claude Code checks per scene

### 1. Background images
- Are all BG images SVG format? Flag any PNG or JPG used as BG.
- Is the SVG inline or imported as a file?
- Is the BG responsive — does it use viewBox correctly?

### 2. All images used
- List every image imported or referenced in the JSX
- Note format: SVG / PNG / JPG / WebP
- Note usage: background / character / icon / decoration / game asset
- Flag any PNG or JPG that could be replaced with SVG

### 3. Duplicates
- Note if the same image file is used in multiple scenes
- Flag if the same visual is saved as separate files per scene (consolidate candidates)

### 4. Broken references
- Does every imported image file actually exist in the folder?
- Flag any import path that looks incorrect or points to a missing file

### 5. File size
- Flag any single image over 200kb
- Flag any scene whose total image weight exceeds 1mb

---

## Format key
- ✅ Good
- ⚠️ Needs attention
- ❌ Fix required
- 💡 Suggestion
